messages:
maya: Uploaded a lean draft of the launch blog (benchmarks + short appendix). Need quick copy + routing check: https://drive.redwood/launch-lean
lina: Skimming now. Can we tighten the opening to one sentence? current lead is a bit long.
kevin: Growth asks that we keep one stat up top and save deeper charts for the appendix. Also want two social hooks ready (stat + demo).
maya: Shortened the lead to one sentence and pulled the headline stat above the fold: 'up to 2.8x lower unit cost in internal tests' (see appendix).
harry: For inbound routing: webinar RSVPs -> marketing:webinar-launch. Demo requests -> ae_queue:LaunchQ. If someone selects both, add both tags. I'll update HubSpot.
ellen: Legal quick note: change to "up to 2.8x" and add "in our internal tests" + link to appendix. Also add trademark symbol after Redwood on first mention.
maya: Updated per Ellen (added 4 and appendix link). publish-bot, can we get a staging preview?
publish-bot: preview ready: https://staging.redwood/preview/launch-lean-5678
sam: Sales wants AE notification email when a demo lead is created. Harry, can you add an AE webhook?
harry: Yep. I'll add the webhook and a conditional workflow: if demo_interest == true, send AE email + add AE tag.
tia: Copy nit: change CTA text from "Request a demo" to "Request a personalized demo"  slightly higher conversion in tests.
maya: Good tweak, updated. Final asks: Lina to deliver mobile hero by EOD, Kevin to finalize social snippets, Harry to finish HubSpot wiring. If all green, I can canary publish tomorrow 9am PST.
lina: Mobile hero queued.
kevin: Social snippets done, scheduling after canary.
harry: HubSpot workflow and AE webhook complete.
maya: Thanks team  will run canary and report back here.
